key.shulkertoolkit.toggle_pick_mode: Switch middle-click take: 1 block / one stack
key.shulkertoolkit.toggle_item_storage_t: Show or hide contents in tooltips
key.shulkertoolkit.toggle_item_held_by_c: Show or hide the cursor item tooltip
config.shulkertoolkit.title: Shulker Toolkit
config.shulkertoolkit.group.tooltips.des: Hover a shulker box, a bundle or an ender chest in any inventory to see what is inside, in a grid with the box colour. The ender chest shows your own ender chest when the server has the mod.
config.shulkertoolkit.item_storage_toolt: When tooltips show the contents grid: always, never, while a key is held, or switched with its key (set in Controls). Otherwise the tooltip says which key shows it.
config.shulkertoolkit.item_storage_color: Tint the grid with the colour of a dyed shulker box; the ender chest is dark teal.
config.shulkertoolkit.item_storage_highl: How the selected item is marked: the light square of a hovered slot, or a frame like the hotbar one.
config.shulkertoolkit.item_held_by_curso: When the box, bundle or ender chest you hold with the cursor shows its contents, so you can scroll through them.
config.shulkertoolkit.nested_item_toolti: Select a box or bundle inside a tooltip and press Enter or Space to look inside it; Backspace goes back. Only to look.
config.shulkertoolkit.icon_marker.descri: What boxes, bundles and ender chests show on their icon: a green + when the box already contains the item you hold and there is room for more, a bar with how many slots of a shulker box are used, both or nothing.
config.shulkertoolkit.group.moving_items: Put items into boxes, bundles and your ender chest, or take them out, without placing them. Needs the mod on the server too; a server may turn parts off.
config.shulkertoolkit.bundle_interaction: Extend the shulker box controls to bundles: their contents grid, right click, dragging, one item at a time and the fits indicator. Off: bundles work as in vanilla.
config.shulkertoolkit.control_scheme.des: Right click only: with a box on the cursor, right-click a stack to put it in or an empty slot to take the selected stack out; right-click a box to put in what you hold or take out. Split: as vanilla bundles, left click puts in and right click takes out.
config.shulkertoolkit.vertical_tooltip_s: While this key is held, the mouse wheel moves the selection up and down instead of left and right.
config.shulkertoolkit.single_item_moveme: While this key is held, clicks move a single item, and the mouse wheel moves items one by one.
Take blocks out of the shulker boxes you carry. Needs the mod on the server too; a server may turn these off.
config.shulkertoolkit.pick_mode: Take from shulkers with middle click
config.shulkertoolkit.pick_mode.single_i: Middle-clicking a block that is only inside a shulker box in your inventory takes one from it.
config.shulkertoolkit.pick_mode.full_sta: Default. Middle-clicking a block that is only inside a shulker box in your inventory takes a full stack from it.
config.shulkertoolkit.auto_refill.descri: When the stack in your hand runs out, refill it from the shulker boxes in your inventory.
config.shulkertoolkit.litematica_auto_ta: With Litematica, right-clicking a spot where a schematic block is missing takes that block out of a shulker box in your inventory; click again to place it. Easy Place and the Litematica Printer always take blocks from your shulker boxes.
config.shulkertoolkit.group.crafting.des: Craft with the materials stored in your shulker boxes. Needs the mod on the server too; a server may turn this off.
config.shulkertoolkit.craft_from_boxes.d: The recipe book of the crafting table and of your inventory counts the materials inside your shulker boxes, and clicking a recipe takes them out into the crafting grid. Off: the recipe book works as in vanilla.
config.shulkertoolkit.craft_depth.descri: Level 1: the shulker boxes in your inventory. Level 2: also the loose items in your ender chest (while you carry one). Level 3: also the shulker boxes inside the ender chest. Level 4: also the bundles inside those shulker boxes.
config.shulkertoolkit.group.pickup.descr: Send items you pick up from the ground into the shulker boxes you carry. Needs the mod on the server too; a server may turn these off.
config.shulkertoolkit.pickup_overflow_to: When an item you pick up doesn't fit in your inventory, it goes into a shulker box in your inventory that already holds that item, or else into the first one with free space.
config.shulkertoolkit.pickup_direct_to_b: Items you pick up go straight into a shulker box in your inventory that already holds them, even if your inventory has room. If you already carry a loose stack of that item, they go there instead; if the box is full, the rest goes to your inventory.
config.shulkertoolkit.group.pinned_windo: Middle-click a shulker box, a bundle or an ender chest in your inventory, a crafting table, a chest or a furnace to open its window next to the screen and use it like a chest. In creative mode, hold Control while middle-clicking. Needs the mod on the server too; a server may turn this off.
config.shulkertoolkit.pinned_windows.des: Middle click opens the window of a box, bundle or ender chest beside the screen, also from inside another window. Click to put items in and take them out; Shift-click moves a stack to your inventory, or from your inventory into the last window you used. Middle-click the box or the window title again to close it.
config.shulkertoolkit.pinned_window_soun: Opening a window plays the opening sound of its box, bundle or ender chest. Only you hear it.
config.shulkertoolkit.max_pinned_windows: How many windows can be open at once. When they don't fit, they are drawn smaller.
config.shulkertoolkit.pinned_windows_alw: Windows always go in columns beside the screen, also with the recipe book open. Off: with the recipe book open, they go above and below it.
config.shulkertoolkit.group.keys.descrip: The same bindings as Options → Controls. Changes apply when you save.
config.shulkertoolkit.key.description: Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape unbinds it.
config.shulkertoolkit.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.shulkertoolkit.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.shulkertoolkit.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
